Legend layout for a set of series labels

Source: R/style.R
gfplot_legend.Rd

Legends in gfplot figures sit under the panel and wrap onto as many rows as the number of series needs, so a wide legend does not squeeze the panel.

Usage

gfplot_legend(labels, base_size = 11, hide_single = TRUE)

Arguments

labels

Series labels the legend will show.

base_size

Base font size, used to scale the legend keys.

hide_single

Hide the legend when only one series is present, where it would only restate the axis. Set to FALSE when the legend carries information, as with the area under the curve printed by plot_ROC().

Value

A ggplot2 guide specification, or "none" for a single series when hide_single = TRUE.

Examples

gfplot_legend(c("Low risk", "High risk"))
